##### `examples/musical/drums-basic.loom`

````loom
---
bpm: 112
signature: 4/4
unit: bar
title: "Drum Pattern"
---

# Drums: 10

> Kick plays four-on-the-floor.
> Focus on beat 2 of the snare: [^ ^ ^] inserts a triplet roll within one beat.

kick  | ^ .  ^      . ^ . ^ . |
snare | . . [^ ^ ^] . . . ^ . |
hihat | . ^  .      ^ . ^ . ^ |
````

##### `examples/musical/drums-complex.loom`

````loom
---
bpm: 120
signature: 4/4
unit: bar
title: "Complex Drum Pattern"
---

# Drums: 10

> Pattern with a crash at the start of bar 1 and a tom fill at the end of bar 2.
> Uses hc (closed) and ho (open) hi-hat contrast for expression.

crash | ^ . . . | . . . . |
hc    | ^ ^ ^ ^ | ^ ^ ^ . |
ho    | . . . . | . . . ^ |
kick  | ^ . . . | ^ . ^ . |
snare | . . ^ . | . . ^ . |
rs    | . ^ . . | . ^ . . |
lt    | . . . . | . . . [^ ^] |
ft    | . . . . | . . . [^ ^] |
````
